subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – coupon code and invoice name
body_text:
Hi Sanjay,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us about your coupon code not applying to the Advanced Course at checkout, and you also asked about a wrong company name on your invoice and extending the coupon's expiry date.

What was completed during the call:
- Following our guidance, you added the Advanced Course to the coupon in the Products section and saved it, and you confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.

What we discussed:
- The coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course, which is why the Advanced Course showed an "Invalid coupon" message.
- You can extend the coupon's expiry date yourself in the coupon settings, where there is a date option.
- The company name in the GST part of your invoice is not yet corrected.

What you need to do next:
1. Extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings (you mentioned you planned to do this that evening).

What we'll do next:
- We will check the wrong company name in the GST part of your invoice and let you know by the day after our call.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-05

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
